interfaces.name: check-bundle

checks.meaning: Deterministic checks. Must include a blocking <port>_schema check per output port

interfaces.failure: Missing blocking schema check per output port, or unpinned bundle on an admitted CC version, rejects admission and binding

interfaces.name: checking-profile

criteria.meaning: Must include the three generic criteria, blocking

interfaces.failure: Any criterion with answerable_from other than declaration_and_output, or a missing generic criterion, rejects admission

check_id.meaning: Lowercase snake_case check name, unique in bundle

target_port.meaning: Output port of the target CC

reads.meaning: Records the runner may read. Each in output, inputs, runtime_records

question.meaning: Question answerable from declaration plus output
